editorPanels.label: Link suggestions
editorPanels.description: Suggests links to your published articles, using words already in your text.

settings.label: Suggestions at a time

settings.description: Words that should never count as a reason to link, one per line. Common words like "the" are already ignored in each language.

actions.description: Re-reads every published article for link suggestions. Use it after a large import.
